Speaker: Jordan Ellis
Text: Thanks for joining. To start, can you tell me a bit about how you handle your energy bills at home?

Speaker: Priya Shah
Text: Sure. I'm the one who deals with all the bills in our house. Energy is by direct debit, but the amount jumps around, so I check the app most months.

Speaker: Jordan Ellis
Text: Tell me about the last time you checked it.

Speaker: Priya Shah
Text: That was in October. The bill was nearly double what I expected. It said estimated in small letters at the top. I hadn't sent a reading since the summer because the reminder came while I was at work and I just forgot.

Speaker: Priya Shah
Text: I went down to the cupboard, took a photo of the meter on my phone, and then typed the numbers into the app. Then I waited about four days for a new bill. I kept the photo in case they argued.

Speaker: Jordan Ellis
Text: How do you feel about sending readings in general?

Speaker: Priya Shah
Text: Honestly I'm pretty good at it. I always do it when I get the reminder.

Speaker: Jordan Ellis
Text: When did you last get the reminder?

Speaker: Priya Shah
Text: Last week I think. It was a text at about eleven in the morning. I was in a meeting so I swiped it away, and I haven't done it yet, now that I think about it.

Speaker: Jordan Ellis
Text: Would you use a feature that read the meter from a photo?

Speaker: Priya Shah
Text: Oh definitely, I'd use that every month.
